title: ScaleRLT: Exact Log-Probabilities and Fast Deferred Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning on Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.34427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped language models such as Ouro reuse one block of layers several times per token. A rollout engine can batch the deeper loops of several response positions and run them only when a deep readout is due. This deferred schedule is fast, but the learner of an on-policy RL algorithm recomputes the sampled tokens' log-probabilities with a dense pass, and the two computations differ in floating point: in FP32 at 4096 tokens about 18% of the sampled tokens miss a $10^{-5}$ same-weight gate, and with bf16 weights nearly every token does. We use a hybrid learner log-probability, $\ell=\ell_{\mathrm{dense}}+\mathrm{sg}(\ell_{\mathrm{sched}}-\ell_{\mathrm{dense}})$, where $\mathrm{sg}$ denotes stop-gradient. Its value is a no-grad replay through the rollout's own schedule, and its gradient is the dense learner's. The replay reproduces the rollout bit for bit in all 167 FP32 and 28 bf16 real-weight cells we ran on three platforms, including roll

translated_title: ScaleRLT：面向循环Transformer强化学习的精确对数概率与快速延迟展开
translated_abstract: 像Ouro这样的循环语言模型在每个token上重复使用同一层块多次。展开引擎可以将多个响应位置的深层循环进行批处理，只在需要深度读取时才运行它们。这种延迟调度速度快，但on-policy强化学习算法的学习器需要通过密集前向传播重新计算采样token的对数概率，而这两种计算在浮点数上存在差异：在4096个token的FP32精度下，约18%的采样token无法通过$10^{-5}$的同权重门限，而使用bf16权重时几乎所有token都无法通过。我们采用混合学习器对数概率 $\ell=\ell_{\mathrm{dense}}+\mathrm{sg}(\ell_{\mathrm{sched}}-\ell_{\mathrm{dense}})$，其中 $\mathrm{sg}$ 表示stop-gradient（停止梯度）。其取值是通过展开自身调度的无梯度重放，其梯度则来自密集学习器。该重放在我们在三个平台上运行的全部167个FP32和28个bf16真实权重单元中逐位复现了展开结果，包括roll……
tldr: 提出ScaleRLT，通过一种取值与延迟展开调度逐位一致、梯度来自密集前向传播的混合对数概率，解决了循环Transformer上延迟展开与on-policy强化学习之间的浮点不一致问题，实现既快速又精确的RL训练。
en_tdlr: ScaleRLT introduces a hybrid log-probability whose value bit-exactly reproduces the deferred rollout schedule while its gradient comes from the dense pass, enabling fast and numerically exact on-policy reinforcement learning on looped transformers.
